titleZh: 平靜 ↔ 騷動｜湖面對暴風
hook: halcyon／equanimity 是鏡面湖，blatant／fray／tumult 是碼頭吵架——救生圈寫著「先深呼吸」。
script: 平靜隊：halcyon／equanimity／serene／placid。騷動隊：blatant／fray／tumult／uproar。考場：寫平靜句用湖，寫衝突句用碼頭擴音器。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 鏡面湖: halcyon walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「鏡面湖」出場：halcyon 一上場梗就黏住——平靜美好的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 佛系椅: equanimity walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「佛系椅」出場：equanimity 一上場梗就黏住——沉著鎮定。

members.senseAnchor: not agitated; without losing self-possession; completely clear and fine

members.senseAnchor: without any attempt at concealment; completely obvious; conspicuously and offensively loud; given to vehement outcry
